name: JetBrains Mono
notes: Ghostty fallback for Control Pictures etc. AppKit name 'JetBrains Mono' silently becomes Helvetica unless this TTF is loaded by URL.

name: JetBrains Mono NoNF
notes: Embedded without Nerd PUA. Useful to see which Control Pictures / PUA are the patch.

name: JuliaMono
notes: Ghostty embedded; strong Unicode / math coverage for a mono.

name: Apple Symbols
notes: Likely the cleanest Apple-native coverage for circled alphanumerics / geometric. Candidate to unify U+2460–24FF.

name: STIX Two Math
notes: Partial enclosed alphanumerics in the current Ghostty mix (23 of 160).

name: Arial Unicode MS
notes: Largest single fallback on this machine (~14k Ghostty cps). Coverage is real but the outlines are a dump, not a designed family. Mixing it with Monaspace/STIX inside one block is the Enclosed Alphanumerics problem.

name: LastResort
notes: Apple last-resort. Treat a hit here as missing, not coverage.

name: PingFang SC
notes: Apple's current SC sans. Native CJK; not a Noto copy. Dominates the Ghostty stack by volume (CJK).

name: VictorMono NFM SemiBold
notes: Nerd Font Mono SemiBold — Latin/mono is Victor Mono; PUA is the Nerd patch.

name: Monaspace Xenon
notes: Shows up for 28 Enclosed Alphanumeric cps in the current mix.

name: Noto Sans Symbols
notes: NOT INSTALLED. Designed coverage for enclosed alphanumerics / geometric. First candidate to unify U+2460–24FF.

name: Noto Sans Symbols 2
notes: NOT INSTALLED. Extended symbols (including later enclosed). Pair with Noto Sans Symbols.

name: DejaVu Sans
notes: NOT INSTALLED. Often complete for circled numbers.

name: Symbola
notes: NOT INSTALLED. George Douros; very wide symbol cmap, outlines are a grab-bag.
